description: Symbol ids on one exchange matching every word of the query, at most 50: crypto and RWA perpetuals alike. Ids look like "perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT", "perpetual-TSLA-USDT:USDT" for a tokenized stock on Binance, or "perpetual-XYZ:TSLA-USDC:USDC" for a Hyperliquid HIP-3 market (dex before the colon). Matching is on the id, so search by ticker (e.g. "TSLA"), not by company name. The free preview symbol is perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT on binance-futures.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "BTC USDT", "ETH perpetual" or "XYZ TSLA". Empty lists the first 50.
